description: No verification process exists to confirm that an authorized agent has permission from the consumer to submit a request on their behalf. CCPA permits consumers to designate authorized agents to exercise rights on their behalf, but businesses must verify both the agent's authority and the consumer's identity to prevent unauthorized requests.
applicability: Authorized agent request processing systems Privacy request intake workflows Third-party service provider integrations Consumer rights management platforms Legal representative request handlers Power of attorney verification systems

metadata.detection_notes: Review CCPA compliance documentation and controls for VERIFY requirements.
